title: NEMO：濕格體積、部分網格與海洋平均
titleEn: NEMO: wet-cell volume, partial cells and ocean means
subcategoryTitle: 地球、流體與離散物理驗證
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「NEMO：濕格體積、部分網格與海洋平均」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付濕體積帳本、遮罩真值表、兩種平均與零分母驗收案例。
summaryEn: Investigate NEMO: wet-cell volume, partial cells and ocean means using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver wet-volume ledgers, a mask truth table, both weighted means and zero-denominator acceptance cases, documenting whether the reported quantity is a volume mean or a heat-content diagnostic.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「有效體積定義」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Define effective volume: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 偏差可能來自漏乘濕分率、分母仍用完整體積或 NaN 汙染；必須同時檢查有效值與權重遮罩。
接受前測試常數場、全陸區與部分濕格；全無有效體積應回報未定義，不得假造零度。
海陸遮罩與部分格點會改變有效體積；未加權溫度平均可能錯判整個水體的狀態。
optionsEn: Bias can result from missing wet fractions, a denominator using full volume or NaN contamination. Inspect value validity and weight masks together rather than cleaning only the final mean.
Before acceptance, test a constant field, an entirely dry region and partial wet cells. Zero valid volume must return an undefined result rather than a fabricated zero temperature.
Land masks and partial cells alter effective ocean volume. An unweighted temperature mean can misrepresent the water body even when every valid temperature value is individually correct.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。海陸遮罩與部分格點會改變有效體積；未加權溫度平均可能錯判整個水體的狀態。 與本階段判準一起判讀：基線總濕體積為四立方米，變更後為二點五。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Land masks and partial cells alter effective ocean volume. An unweighted temperature mean can misrepresent the water body even when every valid temperature value is individually correct. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Total wet volume is four cubic meters initially and two point five after the change.
